title: High School Graduation & Post-Secondary Fork
narrative: You've crossed the stage and received your high school diploma! The world is wide open, but your next step sets the trajectory for your early adult earning power and debt profile.

choices.title: 4-Year University (Bachelor's Degree)
choices.description: Enroll in university. Grants access to lucrative professional corporate careers, but comes with student loan debt and modest work-study earnings during school.

effects.eventMessage: Enrolled in university. Added $24,000 Federal Student Loans and $180/mo tech fees.

choices.title: Skilled Trade Apprenticeship (Electrician / Plumbing)
choices.description: Enter a paid trade union apprenticeship. Zero student debt, solid immediate wages, and practical mastery that is always in demand.

effects.eventMessage: Joined union apprenticeship! Earning $2,600/mo with a small tool loan.

choices.title: Direct Full-Time Workforce (Retail & Logistics)
choices.description: Jump straight into full-time customer service and warehouse shifts. Immediate independence without any loans or school obligations.

effects.eventMessage: Entered full-time workforce at $1,900/mo with zero debt.

title: First Independent Living
narrative: At age 21, it's time to establish your own living arrangement. Housing is typically your single largest monthly expenditure.

choices.title: Solo Downtown Studio Apartment
choices.description: Rent your own studio downtown. Complete privacy and independence, but heavy fixed monthly overhead and credit card debt for furnishings.

effects.eventMessage: Moved into solo studio ($1,350/mo) with $2,200 on a furniture store card.

choices.title: Shared Apartment with 2 Roommates
choices.description: Split a 3-bedroom apartment with reliable roommates. Balances independence with manageable shared bills.

effects.eventMessage: Moved into shared apartment: rent is capped at a manageable $680/mo.

choices.title: Stay at Family Home & Commute
choices.description: Live at home to supercharge your savings rate and eliminate rental drag while launching your adulthood.

effects.eventMessage: Staying at home for now: paying only $250/mo board, leaving cash flow free to invest.

title: Career Launch & Transportation
narrative: At age 24, your training pays off as you enter your career field. Plus, you need reliable transport to sustain your commute.

choices.title: Corporate Associate & Reliable Used Car
choices.description: Step into a corporate salary ($5,200/mo) with a company 401(k) match, driving a reliable certified pre-owned car.

effects.eventMessage: Launched corporate career at $5,200/mo with a 5% 401(k) match and sensible auto loan.

choices.title: Journeyman Contractor & Work Truck
choices.description: Promoted to Journeyman Trade Specialist ($4,800/mo). Finance a dedicated commercial work truck.

effects.eventMessage: Journeyman status achieved! Salary is $4,800/mo with work truck loan.

choices.title: Store General Manager & Economy Commuter
choices.description: Promoted to Store General Manager ($3,400/mo). Modest used commuter car keeps payments low.

effects.eventMessage: Promoted to GM at $3,400/mo with economical $150/mo car payment.

title: Independent Healthcare & Life Shock
narrative: At age 27, you are off parental health insurance. Deciding how to manage risk transfer is a cornerstone of adult personal finance.

choices.title: Comprehensive Health & Disability Policy
choices.description: Secure a solid health insurance policy with modest deductible. Monthly premium safeguards your savings against unexpected medical emergencies.

effects.eventMessage: Active Health Policy established ($180/mo premium, $1,200 deductible).

choices.title: Go Uninsured / High Deductible Gamble
choices.description: Skip paying monthly insurance premiums to keep more cash, but expose yourself to catastrophic hospital bills.

effects.eventMessage: Skipped insurance! An appendicitis scare landed you with a $4,800 medical debt.

title: Marriage & Partnership
narrative: At age 30, you marry your long-term partner! Combining households introduces dual income, but the celebration cost can either build solidarity or spark heavy debt.

choices.title: Intimate Celebration & Dual Income Synergy
choices.description: Host a modest community celebration. Your partner brings a $3,500/mo income into the household with minimal debt.

effects.eventMessage: Married! Added partner income (+$3,500/mo) and joint household expenses.

choices.title: Extravagant Destination Wedding on Credit
choices.description: Host a glamorous resort wedding and European honeymoon funded on high-interest credit cards ($16,000 at 22.9% APR).

effects.eventMessage: Lavish wedding celebrated! Loaded $16,000 onto a 22.9% credit card ($480/mo min payment).

title: Housing & Children
narrative: At age 35, your family is growing with two kids! The defining financial question is whether to buy a home with a mortgage or invest heavily while renting.

choices.title: Buy Suburban Home (30-Year Mortgage)
choices.description: Purchase a 3-bedroom home with a $280,000 mortgage ($1,800/mo payment + $350 property tax & maintenance). Adds childcare costs for two children.

effects.eventMessage: Purchased family home! Added 30-year mortgage and childcare costs.

choices.title: Rent Single-Family Home & Funnel Cash into Index Funds
choices.description: Lease a spacious suburban home ($1,900/mo) with zero maintenance headaches, aggressively funneling remaining surplus into your brokerage.

effects.eventMessage: Renting family house ($1,900/mo) and focusing surplus into index investing.

title: Mid-Career Prime Earning Years
narrative: At age 42, your career hits peak velocity. How do you capitalize on your senior experience?

choices.title: Executive Director / Master Contractor Raise
choices.description: Climb into senior leadership. Your personal income jumps to $8,800/mo, maximizing your retirement savings capacity.

effects.eventMessage: Earned senior executive promotion! Salary increased to $8,800/mo.

choices.title: Launch Independent Consulting / Business Firm
choices.description: Take out a commercial small business loan ($35,000) to build your own agency. Highly rewarding, but demands tight cash flow control.

effects.eventMessage: Launched your business! Revenue is $9,600/mo with a $35k SBA loan.

title: College Tuition & Catch-Up Window
narrative: At age 50, your kids are finishing high school, and you enter the official IRS retirement catch-up window.

choices.title: Cash-Flow Kids' College Tuition
choices.description: Commit $900/mo to ensure your kids graduate college debt-free, giving the next generation a clean start.

effects.eventMessage: Funding kids' college tuition ($900/mo) to break the cycle of student debt.

choices.title: Prioritize Your Own Retirement Catch-Up
choices.description: Kids use federal scholarships and work-study; you supercharge your retirement and index funds before the clock runs out.

effects.eventMessage: Prioritized retirement acceleration! Directing all surplus to compound growth.

title: Pre-Retirement Consolidation
narrative: Age 60! The countdown to retirement is on. Kids are grown and self-sufficient, childcare expenses drop away, and you position your assets for financial independence.

choices.title: Eliminate All Remaining Liabilities
choices.description: Channel all excess cash flow into wiping out any remaining loans or mortgages so you can enter retirement 100% debt-free.

effects.eventMessage: Debt-free sprint initiated! Funneling cash flow to pay off debts.

choices.title: Pivot to High-Yield Dividend & Income Portfolio
choices.description: Shift uninvested capital into cash-flowing assets to generate passive income for your upcoming golden years.

effects.eventMessage: Portfolio pivoted toward dividend stability.

title: Retirement Celebration & Lifetime Score!
narrative: Congratulations! You have reached age 65 and concluded your 50-year financial journey. Let's tally your lifetime net worth, examine the debt traps you survived, and celebrate your generational legacy.

choices.title: Step into Financial Independence
choices.description: Conclude the simulation, evaluate your lifetime financial decisions, and view your final ranking.

effects.eventMessage: 50-Year Simulation Complete! Reviewing your lifetime net worth.
